pkgmetadata.longdescription: qeth is a Qt (PySide6) Ethereum wallet for the desktop, with Ledger hardware-wallet support and a Frame-compatible JSON-RPC server on 127.0.0.1:1248. The Ethereum library stack (web3, eth-*, ledgereth, and their narrowly-pinned compiled deps) is vendored from source into a private tree; PySide6 and the other generic dependencies come from the system.

use.flag: Transaction preview via a bundled local py-evm fork engine
Air-gapped QR signing and camera scanning (pulls Qt Multimedia)
Ledger hardware-wallet support (vendors ledgereth/ledgerblue + the USB/BLE stack)
Install the Falkon browser connector plugin
Install the Chrome/Chromium extension package for manual loading
Install and register the signed Firefox extension
